design.title: Design system
design.lead: Every token, component and state in one place. Generated from packages/tokens/tokens.json — never hard-coded.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The Loop: two links that interlock into a lowercase y. Calm, confident, never loud.
brand.lockupsNote: Horizontal, symbol + wordmark, on Ink and on Linkyo Violet. Clear space equals the height of the “o”.
brand.appIconNote: Paper symbol on Linkyo Violet with a subtle 500 → 600 gradient. Light, dark and tinted appearances for iOS 18+.

color.title: Color
color.description: Warm paper, deep ink, one vivid violet. Spark is rare: live moments and celebration only.
color.scalesNote: Generated in OKLCH around the brand anchors, which stay exact.
color.rolesNote: Components use roles, never scale steps. Ratios are measured on surface in light / dark mode.

type.title: Typography
type.description: Geist for UI and body, Geist Mono for numbers. Self-hosted — no Google Fonts CDN.
type.familiesNote: Arabic glyphs fall through to IBM Plex Sans Arabic automatically.

layout.title: Space, shape & depth
layout.description: 4 px base, 8 px rhythm. Borders first, shadows second.
layout.spacingNote: Only these steps exist in the theme. Anything else fails the build.
layout.elevationNote: Three levels only. Cards use e1, menus e2, dialogs e3.
layout.gridNote: Creator column, dashboard regions and touch targets (px).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Motion explains, never decorates. With Reduce Motion, movement becomes a fade.
motion.durationsNote: Press Play. Turn on Reduce Motion in your OS to see the opacity fallback.
motion.principle1: Micro (120 ms) for hover, press and toggles.
motion.principle3: Slow (320 ms) for sheets and pages. Drag lifts to 1.03 with e3.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Lucide on the web, SF Symbols on iOS. One family per screen, labeled when it matters.
icons.platformsNote: Simple Icons in official shapes. Monochrome by default, brand color on hover.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: One primary action per screen. Verbs first, three words max.
buttons.matrixNote: sm 32 · md 40 · lg 48 · xl 56 (creator page links).
buttons.statesNote: Default, hover, pressed (0.98 + darker), focus (2 px ring, 2 px offset), disabled (40 %), loading.
buttons.loadingNote: Loading keeps the label and the width. Try Publish.
buttons.iconButtonsNote: 40 px on web, 44 pt hit area on touch. Tooltip always — hover or focus one.
buttons.destructiveNote: Danger text in context. A filled button only inside the confirmation dialog.
buttons.confirmBody: It disappears from your page right away. You can undo for a few seconds.

controls.title: Inputs & controls
controls.description: Labels always visible. Errors say what happened and how to fix it.
controls.displayNameHint: This is how fans see you.
controls.urlError: That link didn't load. Check the URL and try again.
controls.universalAddPlaceholder: Paste a link, drop a file, or type…

states.title: States
states.description: Every screen has empty, loading, error, offline and success states — designed, not defaulted.
states.errorBody: Check the URL and try again.
states.offline: You're offline. Changes are saved and sync when you're back.

creator.title: Creator themes
creator.description: Creator pages never use Linkyo colors. A seed color becomes a full palette in OKLCH — and the contrast guard makes a broken combination impossible.
creator.engineNote: Change anything. Every text pair stays at WCAG AA or better, in light and dark.
creator.auditNote: {pass} of {total} pairs pass. Generated live; 4,000 random seeds are tested in CI.
creator.pairingsNote: Self-hosted, OFL. Arabic pages always use the Arabic pairing.
creator.linkStylesNote: Rendered with the theme above. Hover and press work on every style.

pricing.title: Start free. Stay free.
pricing.lead: Everything below is free for good. Pro adds selling and power features later — no card, no notice period.

items.a: Yes. Templates, unlimited links, sections and analytics stay free. Pro will add selling and power features, and nothing that is free today becomes paid.

items.q: Do I need a cookie banner?
items.a: No. Creator pages set no cookies and load no trackers. Videos from YouTube or TikTok load only after a visitor taps, so there is nothing to consent to.
In Frankfurt, Germany. We pick EU providers first and list every processor in our privacy policy.

items.q: Can I use my own photos, colors and fonts?
items.a: Yes. Start from a template, then change colors, fonts and buttons. Linkyo checks every color pair, so text always stays readable.

items.q: Does it work in Arabic and other right-to-left languages?
items.a: Yes. Every template supports Arabic with a proper Arabic typeface and a mirrored layout.
A native iOS app is in the works: edit your page, add links from the share sheet and see your stats in a widget.
